name: Attack Shark M87Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard Blackberry Arabic English
shortDescription: Attack Shark M87Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard Blackberry Arabic English (80% TKL 87-Key Layout / Dual Arabic & English Keycaps / Elegant Blackberry Color Edition / Gasket Mounted Structure / Pre-Lubed White
descriptionHtml:
Attack Shark M87Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard Blackberry Arabic English (80% TKL 87-Key Layout / Dual Arabic & English Keycaps / Elegant Blackberry Color Edition / Gasket Mounted Structure / Pre-Lubed White Jade Linear Switches / Full Hot-Swappable 3-Pin & 5-Pin / 5000mAh Battery / South-Facing Per-Key RGB / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Experience top-tier acoustics and ultra-smooth tactile precision with the Attack Shark M87Pro Tri-Mode Gasket Mechanical Keyboard in Blackberry Edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Crafted in a popular 80% TKL 87-key layout with factory-printed dual Arabic and English keycaps, the M87Pro features flexible tri-mode connectivity (USB-C, 2.4GHz wireless, and Bluetooth 5.0), a Gasket-Mounted design with 5-layer sound dampening, pre-lubed White Jade Linear Switches, 1.2mm single-key slotted flex-cut PCB, south-facing per-key RGB backlighting, and a massive 5000mAh rechargeable battery.
